asset_heavy.reason: Describes itself as asset-light manufacturing; products are windows, perforating systems and clad plates, though plants exist.

big_ticket.reason: Components like perforating guns and window systems are project inputs, but individual sales are moderate; mixed, leaning no.

cyclical_demand.reason: Oil and gas well completions, new commercial construction and luxury residential windows are easily postponed in downturns.

large_customers.reason: Customers include oilfield service companies, but also contractors, glazers and dealers; mixed, mostly mid-size and project-based buyers.

notes: Segments: Arcadia, DynaEnergetics, NobelClad; mixed customer base makes large_customers and big_ticket uncertain.

offers_products.reason: Makes architectural windows, curtain walls, well perforating systems and explosion-welded clad metal plates.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured products; services are incidental to product sales.

people_delivered.reason: Manufacturer of windows, perforating systems and clad metals; value is in goods, not staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Sales are tied to construction projects and well completion activity, not subscriptions or contracts.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to contractors, dealers, oilfield service firms and industrial buyers, not directly to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to contractors, architects, dealers, oilfield service companies and industrial manufacturers.
